genres_tendance.pourquoi_ca_marche: Combination of merge mechanics and physics-based interactions reduces ad fatigue and increases replayability. Players enjoy 'sticky' gameplay loops with minimal skill barriers.
genres_tendance.concurrent_faible_notes: Merge Ball (3.2 stars, 10M+ installs) - poor tutorial and repetitive ads. Merge Stack (3.1 stars, 8M installs) - bugs in early levels, intrusive interstitials.

genres_tendance.pourquoi_ca_marche: Time-pressure sliding puzzles have viral potential on TikTok/short-form video platforms. High retention due to 'one more try' mechanics.
genres_tendance.concurrent_faible_notes: Block Crush Saga (2.9 stars, 5M installs) - no level skip option, aggressive ad frequency after level 20. Time Slide Puzzle (3.0 stars, 4M installs) - missing social features.

genres_tendance.pourquoi_ca_marche: Parkour runners with unique character skins drive organic discovery. Low CPI compared to hypercasual clones.
genres_tendance.concurrent_faible_notes: Parkour Extreme (3.3 stars, 12M installs) - no customization, repetitive environments. Sprint Master (3.4 stars, 9M installs) - missing daily challenges.

genres_tendance.pourquoi_ca_marche: Hybrid idle-clicker with meaningful progression can still work if tied to a strong theme (e.g., 'Robot Factory').
genres_tendance.concurrent_faible_notes: Click Factory (2.8 stars, 7M installs) - no prestige system, poor balancing. Upgrade Empire (3.2 stars, 6M installs) - slow early game.

jeux_a_rehabiliter.probleme: Poor onboarding (no tutorial for merge mechanics), excessive ads (interstitial every 30 seconds), repetitive level design.
jeux_a_rehabiliter.opportunite: Add progressive tutorial with visual cues, reduce ad frequency to every 2 minutes, introduce 3-5 'special levels' per episode to break monotony. Expected rating jump to 4.2+ stars.

jeux_a_rehabiliter.probleme: No level skip option, ads appear during critical gameplay moments, missing progression milestones.
jeux_a_rehabiliter.opportunite: Implement optional level skip (cost: 1 free skip per day), delay ads until after level completion, add achievement system. Potential rating increase to 4.0+ stars.

jeux_a_rehabiliter.probleme: Lack of character customization, repetitive obstacle courses, no social sharing features.
jeux_a_rehabiliter.opportunite: Add 5 starter skins (purchasable via IAP), introduce 3 unique obstacle types per world, add 'speedrun mode' sharing. Could revive interest and push ratings to 4.1+ stars.

recommandation_principale: Focus on the 'merge puzzle with physics' hypercasual niche using Godot 4 for a 14-day MVP. Target games with 3.0-3.4 stars and >5M installs but poor tutorials/ads (e.g., Merge Stack, Merge Bounce). The key is to differentiate with: (1) one unique mechanic (e.g., physics-based merge), (2) reduced ad frequency (1 ad per 2 minutes max), and (3) polished onboarding. Monetize with rewarded ads + optional IAP for cosmetics. Market via TikTok/Instagram Reels showcasing the unique mechanic in 7-10 second clips.
